definitions.explanation: The process of something becoming more advanced, sophisticated, or elevated in quality or complexity. Often used for technology, systems, and methods.

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}の{高度化|こうどか}が{進|すす}んでいる。
{医療|いりょう}の{高度化|こうどか}により{治療|ちりょう}の{選択肢|せんたくし}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: The advancement of medicine has increased treatment options.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}セキュリティの{高度化|こうどか}に{対応|たいおう}するため、{専門|せんもん}{人材|じんざい}の{育成|いくせい}が{急務|きゅうむ}だ。
examples.english: Training specialized personnel is urgent to keep up with the increasing sophistication of information security.

notes:
Formed from {高度|こうど} (advanced, high-level) + {化|か} (-ization). Part of the productive ～{化|か} pattern that creates nouns/suru-verbs meaning "the process of becoming ~." Common in news, business, and academic contexts when discussing modernization and technological progress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高度化|こうどか}する: to become more advanced
- {高度化|こうどか}が{進|すす}む: advancement progresses
- {高度化|こうどか}に{対応|たいおう}する: to respond to increasing sophistication

SIMILAR WORDS (～{化|か} pattern):
- {複雑化|ふくざつか}: complication — becoming more complex (negative nuance)
- {多様化|たようか}: diversification — becoming more varied
- {効率化|こうりつか}: streamlining — becoming more efficient
